content: Cefprozil is a semi-synthetic, broad-spectrum cephalosporin antibiotic. It exists as a mixture of cis and trans isomers, with the cis isomer comprising at least 90% of the mixture. Each cefprozil tablet, designed for oral administration, contains an amount of cefprozil equivalent to either 250 mg or 500 mg of anhydrous cefprozil. In addition to the active ingredient, the tablets also include the following inactive components: hypromellose, magnesium stearate, methylcellulose, microcrystalline cellulose, polyethylene glycol 400, polysorbate 80, sodium starch glycolate, and titanium dioxide. The 500 mg tablets also contain ferric oxide. Cefprozil is also available as an oral suspension, intended for oral administration. The oral suspension contains cefprozil equivalent to either 125 mg or 250 mg of anhydrous cefprozil per 5 mL of the reconstituted suspension. The suspension formulation includes the following inactive ingredients: aspartame, carboxymethylcellulose sodium, anhydrous citric acid, colloidal silicon dioxide, FD&C Yellow No. 6, glycine, microcrystalline cellulose combined with carboxymethylcellulose sodium, polysorbate 80, simethicone, sodium benzoate, sodium chloride, sucrose, and a tutti-frutti flavoring agent.
